sources: The route runs south from Cairo to Aswan by overnight sleeper train, then north along the Nile by cruise to Luxor, then back to Cairo by domestic flight.
In the evening you board the sleeping train south toward Aswan — a practical crossing of the distance that also happens to be one of the more atmospheric ways to travel in Egypt.
Where · Cairo → (sleeper train) → Aswan → Kom Ombo → Edfu → Luxor → (flight) → Cairo
You arrive in Aswan in the morning and board the Nile cruise ship that will be your hotel for the next three nights.
